claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings as PRIMARY mode falsified (JP 0.05-0.43 vs TF-IDF 0.78-0.79 at all scales, true OOS ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 target). As COMPLEMENTARY modes: Citation Heritage AUC 0.79-0.85 (PASS >0.75), Sachverhalt cross-lang 0.282 (PASS >0.2), Dispositiv cross-lang 0.150 (PASS >0.1), Linear Hybrid adversarial PASS at w=0.3-0.4 (JP 0.61-0.67, below TF-IDF baseline). No single representation dominates all three metrics (fundamental two-mode tradeoff).
evidence_summary: 13 evidence_refs verified. Citation heritage: 2 scales (21yr/137k, 22yr/144k), 4 projection variants, 344 positive pairs at 22yr, dense AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74. Section cross-lingual: 3 sections at 1K sample (Sachverhalt 359, Dispositiv 538, Erwaegungen 510), Sachverhalt cp64 0.282, Dispositiv 0.150, Erwaegungen 0.094. Linear hybrid weight sweep: 5 weights at 22yr, optimal w=0.4 (cited) / w=0.3 (hybrid), both adversarial PASS, JP 0.61-0.67 vs TF-IDF 0.78-0.79. v14 independent rerun: 16 combinations × 5 folds, linear_citation_concat CONFIRMED (mean_delta +0.0392, paired_delta_std 0.0212 < 0.03). TF-IDF 174k formal suite: 8/8 PASS both adversarial gates. True OOS ceiling: v8 holdout ~0.53. 6 negative results preserved (dense JP FAIL all scales, Erwaegungen cross-lang FAIL, legal TF-IDF bge_ FAIL, v18 hierarchy FAIL, 24yr embeddings flagged FAILED). Data blockers: bge_/bger_ ID mapping, parquet 2022-2026 (~15.5k decisions), section extraction 174k. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES, continue_recommended=false.
